items.title: President Murmu Confers National Sports Awards; Lalremsiami First from Mizoram to Receive Arjuna Award
items.summary: President Murmu presented the National Sports Awards, where 17 Arjuna awardees and three Dronacharya awardees were chosen. Lalremsiami became the first recipient from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award, while no Khel Ratna was awarded for the first time since 2014.

items.title: India and Egypt Discuss Bilateral Cooperation in Infrastructure, Manufacturing, and Logistics
items.summary: Piyush Goyal visited Egypt to discuss increasing cooperation between India and Egypt in infrastructure, manufacturing, and logistics. Egypt's location provides opportunities for Indian businesses to expand into markets across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

items.title: Kurumba Adivasi Community of Kerala and Census Language Classification Rules
items.summary: The Kurumbas of Kerala are an Adivasi community with a population of 2,719 as of 2024, speaking Kurumba, an oral language without a script. Under Census guidelines, languages spoken by fewer than 10,000 people are classified under the 'others' category.

items.title: Central Government Sanctions Fresh Infrastructure Along China Border in Arunachal Pradesh
items.summary: The Central Government has sanctioned new infrastructure along the border with China in Arunachal Pradesh. The decision comes as tension persists in the region despite high-level border talks held between India and China since July 2026.

items.title: Himachal Pradesh Introduces Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna
items.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government has launched the Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna, offering a ₹1,500 financial allowance scheme. The scheme provides social welfare support to targeted beneficiaries across the state.

items.title: IBM Quantum System to be Installed at Amaravati Quantum Valley
items.summary: An IBM Quantum System from the United States is scheduled for installation at Amaravati Quantum Valley on February 3, 2027, to build an indigenous deep tech hub. Homegrown breakthroughs are emerging from the Amaravati 1Q and Amaravati 1S labs led by Q SHIVA and NAADA.

items.title: Himachal Pradesh Approves ₹1,500 Monthly Assistance for Women and Free Electricity
items.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government has approved ₹1,500 in monthly financial assistance for eligible women. Additionally, eligible beneficiary families under the scheme will receive 300 units of free electricity.

items.title: NPPA Directs Monitoring of Revised Prices for 137 Anti-Cancer Drugs
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has instructed State drug controllers to strictly monitor the market to ensure compliance with the new prices fixed for 137 anti-cancer drugs. Regulators warned that non-compliance with the revised price limits will invite strict official action.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh Secures ₹9.88 Lakh Crore Investment Commitments at CII Partnership Summit
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh secured investment commitments worth ₹9.88 lakh crore during the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Partnership Summit held in Visakhapatnam. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu also announced that the state will implement the Investment Protection Act with retrospective effect from 2024.

items.title: APEC Forum to be Hosted in Shenzhen, China
items.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum is scheduled to take place in Shenzhen, where global leaders are expected to hold sideline meetings. According to the White House, discussions will include proposals regarding nuclear-arms cuts.

items.title: British Author M. John Harrison Wins Booker Prize
items.summary: British author M. John Harrison has been awarded this year's Booker Prize. He has long championed resistance to the status quo, with his latest novel reflecting pessimism about humanity's future.

items.title: Manila to Host Quad Summit in First Non-Quad Country Hosting
items.summary: The Quad Summit featuring leaders from India, the U.S., Australia, and Japan is set to take place in Manila, marking the first time the summit is held in a non-Quad country. The meeting is expected to focus on critical minerals, energy supply chains, and safety of seafarers.

items.title: Pioxaniliprole Launched as India’s First Indigenous Insecticide
items.summary: Pioxaniliprole has been introduced as India's first indigenously developed insecticide. The development marks a significant achievement in domestic agricultural science and technology.

items.title: India and Egypt Seek to Expand Bilateral Trade and Investment
items.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal stated during an event in Cairo that bilateral trade between India and Egypt reached around $6.5 billion. Both nations are working to strengthen their economic and investment cooperation.

items.title: AirTrunk Announces $11 Billion Data Centre Investment in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: AirTrunk plans to make an $11 billion investment to build data centres in Andhra Pradesh. The project represents a significant boost to state digital infrastructure.

items.title: Jharkhand Celebrates Foundation Day on November 15
items.summary: President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi greeted residents of Jharkhand on its foundation day. The state was created on November 15, 2000, from the southern region of Bihar.

items.title: India Votes Against UNGA Resolution on Global Moratorium on Death Penalty
items.summary: India voted against a United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) resolution calling for a global moratorium on the death penalty. The resolution noted concern over a surge in reported executions globally in 2025.

items.title: PM Modi Pays Tribute to Birsa Munda on Birth Anniversary
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to tribal freedom fighter Birsa Munda, known as 'Dharti Aaba', on his birth anniversary. He commemorated his courage and sacrifice in inspiring generations to defend self-respect and rights.

items.title: India and Belgium Hold Bilateral Naval Talks on Maritime Security
items.summary: India and Belgium conducted bilateral naval talks focused on maritime security. The engagement aimed to strengthen maritime cooperation and deepen navy-to-navy relations between the two nations.

items.title: Cape Verde Prepares for Presidential Election with Potential First Female President
items.summary: Cape Verde could elect its first woman president since gaining independence in 1975. Six candidates are competing in the election, with a runoff planned for November 29 if no candidate secures over half the votes.

items.title: NATO Scales Back Meetings and Skips Planned Leaders' Summit in Albania
items.summary: NATO will skip a planned leaders' summit in Albania next year as high-level meetings are scaled back. NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte addressed the change, noting that the organization remains flexible regarding its summits.

items.title: UN Climate Summit Grapples with Crossing of Paris Accord's 1.5°C Target
items.summary: Nations at the UN climate summit discussed the imminent crossing of the Paris accord's 1.5°C target threshold. The UN declared in September that global temperatures have already warmed about 1.4°C above pre-industrial levels.

items.title: SpaceX Starship Achieves First-Ever Capture by Launch Pad Arms
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship returned from orbit and was successfully captured by launch pad arms for the first time in a major technical achievement. Launches of Starship from Florida's Kennedy Space Center are expected to begin within the coming months.

items.title: Indian Railways to Launch Train Service Connecting Nepal's Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya
items.summary: Indian Railways will operate a weekly train service connecting Nepal's Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya Dham. The service will stop at several major stations including Jaynagar, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, and Gorakhpur.

items.title: NASA's Voyager 1 Nears One Light-Day Distance Record in Interstellar Space
items.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is approaching a distance of one light-day in interstellar space, setting a new distance milestone. The spacecraft will require approximately 18,000 years to complete a full light-year distance.

items.title: India Wins U-19 Asia Cup; Aaryavir Sehwag Named Player of the Tournament
items.summary: India won the U-19 Asia Cup in Oman by defeating Pakistan in the final match. Aaryavir Sehwag was awarded Player of the Tournament after scoring a tournament-high 361 runs across five matches.

items.title: Lakshya Sen Wins Kumamoto Masters Japan Open Badminton Title
items.summary: Indian badminton player Lakshya Sen defeated Japan's Koki Watanabe 13-21, 21-18, 21-14 to claim the Kumamoto Masters Japan Open title.

items.title: India Beats Bhutan 2-1 to Reach SAFF Championship Final; VAR System Debuts
items.summary: India defeated Bhutan 2-1 to enter the final of the SAFF Championship. The match featured the historic debut of the Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system in the SAFF Championship.

items.title: Sooryavanshi Becomes Youngest Captain in Men's T20 Cricket History
items.summary: Sooryavanshi became the youngest captain in the history of men's T20 cricket. During his record-breaking outing, he scored 18 runs off 12 deliveries before being dismissed by left-arm pacer Chetan Sakariya.

items.title: NIELIT to Host 3rd National Conference on Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics and Intelligence in New Delhi

items.title: DPIIT and Commerce Department to Issue Defence Industrial Licences
items.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) alongside the Commerce Department will now issue defence industrial licences. This measure standardizes administrative oversight for manufacturing within the defence sector.

items.title: MeitY Opens Consent Manager Registration Portal
items.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has launched the Consent Manager Registration Portal. The portal enables digital registration and consent management procedures under government oversight.

items.title: U.S. Assures India of Comparative Tariff Advantage in Trade Negotiations
items.summary: The United States has assured India of a comparative tariff advantage over competing nations during ongoing trade discussions. Indian officials had designated this tariff advantage as a prerequisite for proceeding with a bilateral trade deal.

items.title: SpaceX Achieves Historic First-Ever Starship Rocket Catch

items.title: Wholesale Inflation Rises to 12.29% in October Led by Fuel and Power
items.summary: According to provisional government data, wholesale inflation surged to 12.29% in October, driven by a 32.84% rise in fuel and power prices. Primary articles recorded 9.24% inflation, while manufactured products eased slightly to 9.54%.

items.title: NMC Asks Medical Colleges to Onboard PM-RAHAT Cashless Emergency Care Scheme
items.summary: The National Medical Commission (NMC) has asked government medical colleges to onboard the PM-RAHAT scheme. The scheme provides cashless treatment of up to ₹1.5 lakh per road accident victim for up to seven days at designated hospitals.
